items: Dormant-cleanup batches have caught mailboxes that were actually on a custody list, so I want any disable cross-checked against open legal holds before it runs.
A disabled mailbox stops accepting inbound mail, and if that account is under preservation we can lose evidence, so I treat audit cleanup near legal as something to confirm.
Finance sees an inbox as dormant when nobody is logging in, but Legal may still need it receiving mail, so I want the hold owner consulted before tenant-audit disables land.
The May tenant-audit batch is built after Legal clears it against the custody list, so a mailbox named in that batch already has no open-hold overlap.
I run the tenant-audit cleanup and disabling an audit-listed dormant account is reversible hygiene that is pre-cleared on my side once the account is on the batch.
When Finance names a specific mailbox in the audit batch, the dormant status and hold check are already done, so the disable is routine for me.
